product_overview: Cloud Global SL is a corporate website for a cloud services and technology company, designed to present its offerings, build trust, and help visitors understand its solutions and contact the business. The site also includes lightweight interactive elements such as language switching, theme toggling, a contact form, and mock portal access.
core_goals: Learn what Cloud Global SL offers across cloud infrastructure, IT services, cybersecurity, and related support
Browse the company’s solutions, services, industries, partners, and company background
Switch the site language to view content in Spanish, English, or French
Toggle between light and dark visual themes
Submit a contact inquiry through the website form
Access the mock customer portal login page

features.name: Multilingual Site Navigation
features.description: Allows visitors to switch the website content between Spanish, English, and French.
user_flows: Navigate to /#inicio -> Click the EN language switch -> See the site content translate to English -> Click the FR language switch -> See the site content translate to French -> Click the ES language switch -> See the site content translate to Spanish

features.name: Theme Switching
features.description: Lets visitors alternate the site appearance between light mode and dark mode.
user_flows: Navigate to /#inicio -> Toggle the theme setting -> See the page background change to dark mode -> Toggle the theme setting again -> See the page background change to light mode

features.name: Cookie Consent Handling
features.description: Displays a cookie consent banner and lets visitors acknowledge it.
user_flows: Navigate to /#inicio -> See the cookie consent banner at the bottom of the page -> Accept all cookies -> See the banner disappear

features.name: Contact Inquiry Form
features.description: Provides a contact form for visitors to send a message after completing the on-page security verification.
user_flows: Navigate to /#contacto -> Enter a name -> Enter a corporate email address -> Complete the cloud security verification -> Submit the form -> See a success toast notification

features.name: Mock Customer Portal Login
features.description: Provides a login form for the customer portal mock experience.
user_flows: Navigate to /#login -> Enter a corporate email address -> Enter a password -> Submit the login form

routes.description: Homepage with hero banner and highlights
Differentiated service details and accordion sections
Corporate history timeline and core values
Trusted partner logos and channel integrator strip
Dynamic contact form with verification captcha

features.name: Language Switcher
features.description: Switch between ES, EN, and FR languages dynamically
user_interactions: Click "EN" language switch button in navigation
See site text translate to English
Click "FR" language switch button in navigation
See site text translate to French
Click "ES" language switch button in navigation
See site text translate to Spanish

features.name: Theme Toggle
features.description: Toggle between light mode and dark mode
user_interactions: Click theme toggle button in navigation
See body background change to dark
Click theme toggle button again
See body background change to light

features.name: Cookie Consent Banner
features.description: Bottom banner requesting cookie accept or reject
user_interactions: See cookie banner at bottom
Click "Aceptar todas" button
See cookie banner disappear

features.name: Contact Form Submission
features.description: Contact page form with dynamic security verification
user_interactions: Enter values in Name and Corporate Email fields
Click the Nube (Cloud) security verification icon
Click "Enviar" button
See success toast notification

features.name: Client Portal Mock Login
features.description: Portal login page mock with sign in fields
user_interactions: Enter email in Corporate Email field
Enter password in Password field
Click "Acceder a mi panel" button
